packages.label: דֶּרֶךְ וְזִוּוּג
packages.label_en: The Path and the Celestial Union
packages.reason: The single bechina edge in the Torah 112 dataset equates דרך (path/treading) with זיווג (celestial union). The context in line 31 of the source text is: 'דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל' (Numbers 24:17) — when prayer ascends through the correct tribal gate (שבט), the treading/path of the star from Jacob produces a celestial union above. דרך and זיווג share the same essential nature here: they are both expressions of the upward movement of prayer that connects and unites above. This is a positive, holy domain — the proper channeling of prayer through one's tribal path produces divine union above.

source_edge.proof: דֶרֶךְ הוּא בְחִינוֹת זִוּוּג, מִלְּשׁוֹן (בְּרֵאשִׁית ו): "כִּי הִשְׁחִית כָּל בָּשָׂר אֶת דַּרְכּוֹ".
